Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableGodRays_Too: When enabled, sun rays will be visually rendered on the screen during sunrise and sunset, depending on the sun's position.
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_EnableStormMood_T: When enabled, storms can push a cinematic desaturation + darker ambient mood (with smooth fade).
Sandbox_HereGoesTheSun_StormMoodPreset_T: Choose how strong the storm desaturation should be: Soft, Recommended, Night of the Living Dead (Black & White).
description: Transforms every sunrise and sunset into rich seasonal moods, reshaping the world's light with emotion… or casting a beautiful glow over the three-year-old corpse of your survivor on an autumn floor.
name: Here Goes The Sun
